expectedFailClosedBehavior: After Sixth Amendment is effective, operative §6.01(j) text must be the Notes-only version. If Sixth Amendment Effective Date is CONDITIONAL_UNRESOLVED, status must not silently resolve to the Notes-only text as of execution date alone.
